action.sql: SELECT supplier_id, product_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date<'2024-03-01') AS n_b, avg(delay_days) FILTER (WHERE order_date<'2024-03-01') AS d_b, count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date>='2024-03-01') AS n_a, avg(delay_days) FILTER (WHERE order_date>='2024-03-01') AS d_a FROM purchase_order GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY d_a DESC
